strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Oh, so this area is close to Earth.
It is. Looking at Earth like this... the war hardly seems real.
I wonder how Gramps and the others are doing...
Heh, missing your mommy, Kappei?
Shut up, stupid! I'm just worried about everyone on Earth...!
Now, now, you two, no fighting.
Geez, Daisuke's right! You two are always fighting...
Hahaha, Keiko, guys build friendships by fighting! Right, Boss?
Yeah, that's right, I tell ya.
Geez, what if somebody gets hurt...
Keiko's right. Kappei, Uchuta, you too...
Leave them be, Jun. Having friends to fight with is a blessing in itself.
Unlike us back then...
Tetsuya...
...Huh, that thing floating over there is...
Something there? ...Oh, a Jovian Lizard Tulip.
They send mecha from Jupiter through those, right?
...Why don't we go around smashing them all?
Attack them carelessly and Jupiter may send drones to defend them.
So the call is that we shouldn't touch them without good reason.
Nothing's ever easy, huh... What? An alarm!?
Enemies ahead, crime syndicate mecha. All hands, prepare to launch!
Tch, Uchuta! Our match is on hold! Don't you run away!
Heh, that's my line!
Geez, these brats sure are lively.
My, my, Kappei and the others don't want to hear that from you, Shinobu.
What was that, Sara!? You calling me a brat!?
Guess he really has no clue...
Good grief. He's a hopeless case.
Heh heh heh, here they come... This time I got me a strong helper.
Like moths flyin' right into the flame!
So they are the warriors of Earth...
Yup. They may not look it, but they're a real handful. Don't take 'em lightly.
I know. Even when hunting a rabbit, a lion gives its all...
I too am a swordsman, however humble. I shall not be careless.
Good, I'm countin' on ya! ......Okay, looks like those guys ain't here...
Those guys...?
Uh, yeah, there's this bunch always gettin' in our way... Don't see 'em.
Let's wrap this up quick!
Heh, had they any skill, I'd have liked to cross blades... Another time.
...Have at you, warriors of Earth!
Nngh! You there, what is your name!
...Blue Jet!
I am Globine! Jet, was it? I look forward to meeting you again...!
...This reading!? Captain Bright! Gravity wave reaction from the Tulip!
What? A reaction from the Tulip...?
Tch, in the middle of a battle with the Gyandlar, of all times...
All hands, be ready for enemies from Jupiter too!
Easy for him to say.
Looks like they sent a battleship class... Hm? That ship is...?
Why... Why is that thing coming out of a Tulip...?
Why is that ship coming out of a Jovian machine...?
The Nadesico...?
Ship has now returned to normal space. Checking coordinates...
Everyone, please wake up. Hellooo, yoo-hoo...
Hey, Jovian mecha are showing up behind the Nadesico!
Please wake up, everyooone.
Once awake, report to your stations at once. Emergency alert.
Captaaain. Captain... Captain...
Huh? Ah... Oh, what's the situation outside?
Yes... Near the moon. Surrounded by Jovian Lizards and space criminals...
...!! Fire the Gravity Blast! Then raise the field and fall back!
Ngh, our allies... weren't caught in that...?
Whoa! They show up and start blasting right away!? That's crazy.
They're on the Federation's side, right? Can we trust them?
Crazy, sure... But they seem to have pursuers.
To clear a path, it's not such a bad move.
Well, as long as they don't drag us into it, I don't care.
She sure likes it flashy. Isn't that a bit too close for comfort?
Nadesico, respond!
This is Captain Bright of the Ra Cailum! Nadesico, respond!
Mm... Where...? Huh, who...? C-Captain, Captain Bright's calling!
Huh? Huh? Captain Bright, you mean...
The Ra Cailum's captain, whom we gave the slip amid the chaos
of battle at the Satsuki Midori 2 ruins.
Which means... Londo Bell is in this area too?
I was about to say so when you gave the order to attack.
Ahaha... I-I hope that attack didn't catch them...
A-anyway, please put him through.
Captain Misumaru, what on earth is this...
Ehehe, well, um, we got surrounded by enemies on Mars,
and we had nowhere left to run, so I thought maybe we'd just
go into the Tulip right in front of us...
(Go into a Tulip? ...I thought they were mere transport carriers...)
Inez can explain all that...
Wait, is Inez still out cold?
......Very well. We are currently
engaged in combat with the space crime syndicate Gyandlar.
We'll intercept them along with the Jovian Lizards you brought.
We'd like your ship's cooperation as well. Is that agreeable?
Yes, roger thaaat! Megumi, is everyone awake?
Yes, it looks like everyone's at their stations...
Oh? A message from Captain Bright.
What is it? Something he forgot to say?
"Kindly refrain from wide-area attacks without warning," he says.
Nobody wants to get caught in friendly fire, after all.
Geez, he could've just said so. Captain Bright, you're so shy!
Well... it does affect the morale of the whole force.
While you're fooling around, the enemy's second wave is coming.
Aestivalis team, launch as soon as you're ready!
All right, Jovian Lizards or space crime syndicate,
I'll take 'em all down!
Looks like some small mecha slipped in before the Tulip
we entered got destroyed.
Okay, all units, launch! Then scatter and take 'em out one by one!
What's the plan?
Play it by ear!
Roger! Still, we escape one battle and land right in another...
What the heck!? A whole buncha little ones showed up again!
Hmm... But it seems some robots oppose them as well...
That spares us the trouble of sowing chaos. We go too, Devil Saturn!
Ngh, there are just too many enemies. At this rate...
Brother, don't you start whining!
This is great!
I got spooked when another battleship showed up, but thanks to them
little bug-lookin' robots, we're on a roll!
It is rather like snatching the spoils while others fight...
But this is the job I took on. Earthlings, think no ill of me.
We got this! Now our Demon Soldier ranking's sure to go up!
...If those guys hadn't been around, it'd always have gone like this!
Kenrou! Show me your power!
Whoo, gives me chills every time! That's a real champion of justice!
Tenkawa! We're doing that next!
Akito, you're so cool!
I haven't done it yet! And I won't! ...Anyway, they're helping us again!?
Thanks for the help! Even if we still don't know who you are!
They are pretty out of the ordinary.
That helps. ...Though I don't like not knowing who they are.
True, for now all we know is that they're out of the ordinary.
"Out of the ordinary" is harsh. We were just born someplace else, is all.
Enough, Drill.
(So... they're from another planet...?)
Sorry, everyone. We can't explain in detail right now...
There are some unfamiliar faces among the Gyandlar...
Stay sharp, everyone... These Gyandlar aren't like the usual ones.
Oh ho, you read my swordsman's aura...
So you too are a swordsman. Then face my Dark Twin Slayer Sword!
Interesting. The Tenku Shinken accepts your challenge!
Looks like those two are off in a world of their own...
Either way, we've got more allies! Let's hit the enemy all at once!
Huh? Eek, don't fly so rough!
Roll, don't get too worked up...
It's no use.
Seeing that guy show up got Roll even more fired up than usual.
Your opponent is me! Haaah!!
Nngh! You are skilled!
I too have met a true swordsman for the first time in ages...!
You! What is your school!
Dark Twin Slayer Sword!!
Nngh! You there, what is your name!
...Blue Jet!
I am Globine! Jet, was it? I look forward to meeting you again...!
H-hey! Don't just go off on your own!
Dark Twin Slayer Sword... Globine. Someday... I must cut him down.
H-hey! Don't just go off on your own!
Dark Twin Slayer Sword... Globine. Someday... I must cut him down.
Nngh...! I withdraw! But the wound to my warrior's pride... I shall not forget!
What the heck!? This really ticks me off! Forget it! Retreat!
Enemy readings... gone.
The commander-class units seem to have fully withdrawn.
Keep scanning. ...Now, then.
Shall we go too, Rom?
Yes. If they escape now, we'll lose them again. Everyone, after them!
All right!
My lady, let us be off!
People of Earth, we will pursue the Gyandlar.
When the time comes, we will surely meet again. Farewell!
Roll, let's go after them too!
If we follow the Gyandlar, we might run into Bunker!
Wait, Pai! They brought along different allies...
Their ties with Bunker might not be that strong...
True... Either way, it's clear Bunker is targeting Earth.
No need to rush.
Then maybe staying near Earth is better than chasing the Gyandlar.
Bunker never truly trusts anyone, even an ally...
With the Gyandlar too, they're surely just using each other.
Just as they did with me...
Shazara...
The mysterious power suit team has left scanning range.
Power suits... Surely not.
...However many times I see them, they don't seem like power suits.
...Ruri, they weren't wearing space suits, were they?
...I don't care.
Aww, now she's sulking. Well, I'd say they're kinda dreamy.
(They didn't show up on the Nadesico's radar again,
and Omoikane says they're unidentified... It's definitely strange.)
So in the end, we still couldn't learn who they are.
...I'd be lying if I said I wasn't curious who they are.
Tch, it's a little late to be surprised by stuff like that.
So, Bright, what now?
For now... it's the Nadesico, huh?
For now, the ones we can identify come first...
Captain Misumaru, whatever the reason, I can't let you go this time...
For the time being, you'll accompany us.
Captain Misumaru, given that our operation on Mars has failed,
Nergal can't afford any more friction with the Federation Forces...
But the Nadesico is a civilian battleship...
Understood. For now, the Nadesico will be under Londo Bell's command.
Yurika!
Tenkawa, the safety of the crew and the Earth Sphere
is what the Captain put first.
If we fight Londo Bell now, it'll only please Zeon and the invaders...
W-Well, sure, but...
If you'll excuse me. We'll be heading for our next destination at once.
Partly because the Gyandlar held us up for quite a while...
We did stir things up ourselves, too.
Captain Bright doesn't talk in circles. You're reading too much into it.
He's not slick enough to talk in circles anyway.
A guy who's a little clumsy is kind of cute, don't you think? Hehe.
Ahem! ...I'll get Admiral Misumaru's approval later... Welcome aboard.
Roger! ...Seems like a pretty quirky bunch.
Look who's talking.
...She's got a point.
